_comment: DoomArena3D scene — first-person, full 3D aim. Tick 0.05s for snappy combat. position_scale=1.0 because positions are in world units (meters), not pixels.
_ground_doc: Engine ground primitive (Tier 2.6r): creatures (tag) clamp to Y=0, projectiles (tag) despawn below it. Replaces what creature_bounds + projectile_floor_despawn rules used to do — engine-level instead of content-level.
